findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "feedback" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: rekvira_account, record_assessment, list_assessments, submit_feedback, notifications, feedback, list_regulations, search_regulation, search_regulations, lookup_obligations, read_unit, list_workflows, get_workflow · Private data: connect, whoami, record_assessment, list_workflows, save_workflow, publish_workflow, delete_workflow · Public sink: connect, connect_verify, rekvira_account, start_here, record_assessment, list_assessments, submit_feedback, notifications, feedback, list_regulations, search_regulation, search_regulations, lookup_obligations, verify_citation, read_unit, list_workflows, get_workflow, save_workflow, publish_workflow, delete_workflow · Destructive: rekvira_account, notifications, delete_workflow.
